title: NBA says planned Europe league will draw record investment

blocks.text: The NBA will make what it calls the biggest investment ever into European basketball when it starts a new league there in 2027, deputy commissioner Mark Tatum said in a meeting with reporters on Tuesday. Tatum, speaking a few hours before the start of the NBA season, said again that the planned October 2027 launch date of the new league — a merit-based one where teams can play their way in by qualifying from other leagues — remains in place. He did not divulge any other specific timelines, such as when the lineup of initial teams will be revealed. READ: Adam […]...
